LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_EnableVehicleFrame: Enable Vehicle Mod Caravan Speed Support
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_CaravanSpeedMultip: Scales the caravan speed bonus (left = faster, right = slower). Examples: 0.5 = 200% (2x speed), 1.0 = 100% (unchanged), 2.0 = 50% (halved). Has no effect if there is no base speed bonus.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MinTicksPerMove_To: Caps maximum caravan speed (1 tick/tile = 60000 tiles/day, the vanilla engine limit). Pathfinding is protected by this mod, so even 1 tick/tile will not cause spiral walking or routing failures.
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_CaravanSpeedNotCha: No effect because speed bonus not exists
LanguageData.KTK_CaravanSpeedPatch_MinTicksClamped: Ticks per move clamped to minimum: {1} (calculated: {0})
